failure_surface: Decision 005 state-revision exact-member contract acceptance versus Stage 2 canonical immutable-reference parsing

oracles.title: state-revision membership accepts noncanonical percent spelling
oracles.contract_observation: The current state-revision member-ref regex permits any uppercase percent triplet in reference components, so %2E is accepted even though '.' is RFC3986-unreserved.
oracles.identity_observation: Stage 2 parse_immutable_ref rejects this spelling because canonical component encoding requires unreserved '.' to remain literal.
oracles.pass_oracle: Every member reference accepted by state-revision.schema.json must also be accepted unchanged by parse_immutable_ref with the field-required kind.

oracles.title: state-revision membership dollar-anchor accepts a final LF that the parser rejects
oracles.contract_observation: Under the repository's Python/jsonschema validator semantics, the current ^...$ member-ref pattern accepts a match immediately before one final LF.
oracles.identity_observation: Stage 2 parse_immutable_ref rejects the same value because the digest component is no longer exactly 64 lowercase hex characters and the complete reference is noncanonical.
oracles.pass_oracle: State-revision exact-member fields must use true complete-string semantics equivalent to the canonical parser rather than validator-sensitive $ behavior.
